utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Eli — any news on the carpool? I’m trying to plan my errands around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No news yet, but I’m checking my usual time and I’ll let you know as soon as I have a clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, thanks — I’ll keep my errands flexible for now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what time are we doing the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s do 8:15 AM. I’ll text you when I’m outside.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll be ready at 8:15.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we still on for the carpool this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I just need to double-check the timing and where we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — can you confirm the time and pickup spot when you check?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the carpool. I’m still in for it; just remind me what time we’re leaving again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re leaving at 7:30, so be ready a few minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — 7:30, and I’ll be ready a little early. Thanks for the reminder!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the pickup time and address, just so I get the details right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it was around 7:30, and we’re meeting at my place on Maple Street. Sorry, I’m a little hazy on the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries — I’ll wait for you to confirm the exact time and address before I make any plans.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — did I miss the carpool plan?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — you didn’t miss it. We’re still figuring out the carpool, so you’re right on time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I can take a turn driving if that helps. What days are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — how about 7:30 in the morning? I can bring my extra set of jumper cables too, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7:30 works for me — I’ll be ready then. And good call on the jumper cables, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the carpool locations sorted—just tell me the pickup spot and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — let’s use the front of the school for pickup, and I’ll send you the exact time shortly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — front of the school for pickup. I’ll keep an eye out for your exact time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Quinn — I haven’t heard any carpool updates yet, but I’m happy to keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — I’ll do the same and let you know if I hear anything first. Appreciate you keeping an ear out!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything about the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow? If so, what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yep, we’re still on — can you be ready by 8:15?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I can be ready by 8:15. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the carpool plan to the others and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m glad you’ll pass it along. I’m still catching up, so I appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll let everyone know the carpool details and circle back if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’m glad to sort out the carpool with you. What days and pickup times work best?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa — weekdays work best for me, and around 7:30 in the morning is usually good.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, weekdays at 7:30 works for me too. I’ll line up the route and we can confirm the first pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Eli — I’ve heard the carpool might need one more driver this week, but I’m not totally sure yet. I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Tess. Let me know when you’ve checked, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check with the folks in the carpool and get back to you as soon as I know. Then you can plan around the final count.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — what’s the carpool plan?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’m picking up Sam and Lina at 8, then we’ll swing by your place on the way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks — I’ll be ready at my place at 8.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Around 8:15 would help me a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 8:15 works for me. I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the pickup time and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll text you the pickup time and the corner to meet at in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—I'll watch for your text.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I can help coordinate the carpool and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — before you set it up, can you confirm who’s riding and what time we’re leaving?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check with everyone and confirm the riders and departure time soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the carpool. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can check the schedule and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — just let me know when you’ve checked it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’ll take a look now and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow—do you want me to cover the early pickup?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. I can take the later pickup and handle the route from there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll grab the early pickup tomorrow. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. What time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s leave at 7:30 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7:30 works for me — I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do it, but I’d like to make sure the pickup time and route are clear first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what pickup time works best for you, and which route do you want to take?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s do 7:30, and the usual route should be best for me. If anything changes, please let me know ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I can ask around and see who wants in for the carpool. If you want, I’ll start lining people up right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Quinn. I’ll keep track of who still needs a ride.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll get on it and send you names as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can do the school run if we keep the pickup time the same. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks Faye — I’ll keep the pickup time the same and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Oren — I’ll plan on it then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m getting the carpool list sorted now. Do you want me to save you a spot for the morning run?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes please—if you’ve got room, save me a spot for the morning run. Thanks for keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got you down for the morning run. I’ll send the updated pickup time soon.
